title: What's New (v4.2.0)
summary: Shield readiness is clearer, planned-session reminders are stronger, XP and Focus Score foundations are in place, account sync protects more state, and purchase, setup, and session notifications are more reliable.
notes:
## What's New
- Shield now clearly tells you when apps or permissions are missing before a focus session
- Planned Sessions now send stronger reminders and keep missed sessions visible instead of making them disappear
- New XP, levels, and Focus Score foundations reward real focus quality, not random tapping
- Cleaner Goblin reactions for streak risk, comebacks, XP moments, and missed planned sessions
- Account sync now protects more progress, settings, and planned-session state across reinstalls
- Purchase and account setup flows are more stable
- Session notifications are more reliable during active focus sessions

title: What's New (v4.1.2)
summary: Onboarding, app selection, smaller-screen layouts, device consistency, Shield setup, visual polish, stability, and performance all feel cleaner and more reliable.
notes:
## What's New
- Onboarding is smoother and easier to follow
- Choosing apps for your Shield is now faster and more intuitive
- Better layout and spacing on smaller screens
- Improved consistency across different devices
- Cleaner visuals with more refined spacing and typography
- Shield setup is now faster and more reliable
- General polish and stability improvements
- Better Performance across the app

title: What's New (v4.1.1)
summary: Selected apps stay pinned while editing, Shield actions are more consistent, yearly pricing is clearer, legal dialogs are easier to close, and launch flows received polish.
notes:
## What's New
- Selected apps now stay pinned while you build or edit your block list
- Shield editing actions now match the rest of the app controls
- Yearly Pro pricing is clearer with the monthly equivalent up front
- Terms and Privacy dialogs are shorter, scrollable, and easier to close
- Small launch polish across paywall, Shield, and onboarding flows

title: Sharper focus, stronger control
summary: Manual Block outside sessions, session objectives used in reactions, mid-session adjustments, smarter guidance, Planned Sessions for Pro, improved personalities, UI & performance refinements.
notes:
## What's New
- Manual Block — stronger control outside sessions
- Session objectives visible and used in reactions
- Adjust session mid-focus without restarting
- Smarter focus guidance (drift + burnout nudges)
- Planned Sessions added to Pro
- Improved personality responses

## Improvements
- UI consistency, notification reliability, performance, and stability

## Result
More control. Less excuses.

title: Text system got smarter
summary: CogniFocus now has a stronger text foundation for future language support and character-based app voice improvements. This update also includes clearer legal and update messaging, plus polish across key screens.
notes:
## Text system improved
This update prepares CogniFocus for future language support and more personality-aware text across the app.

## What's improved
- Improved the text system to support future localization
- Prepared the app for character-based voice and UI copy in later updates
- Made legal and update-related text clearer
- Continued polish across Settings, onboarding, and content screens

## Overall result
This release mostly improves the foundation, making future updates cleaner and more flexible.

title: More accessible, easier to follow
summary: This update adds support for reduced motion, stronger contrast, and color-vision options. It also improves how new updates are shown inside the app.
notes:
## Accessibility expanded
CogniFocus is now easier to use for more people, while update messages inside the app are clearer.

## What's improved
- Added reduced motion support
- Improved contrast for readability
- Added color-vision support options
- Added an in-app What's New dialog
- Made update messaging clearer

## Overall result
The app feels more inclusive and makes it easier to notice meaningful updates.

title: Shield got more reliable
summary: Focus Shield now holds up better during active sessions, especially in tougher distraction cases. This update also includes UI consistency and accessibility improvements.
notes:
## Shield got stronger
This release improves how reliably Shield responds when distractions happen.

## What's improved
- Improved Shield reliability during focus sessions
- Strengthened distraction monitoring in tougher cases
- Added accessibility improvements across multiple screens
- Improved UI consistency in different parts of the app

## Overall result
Shield feels more dependable when it matters most.

title: Daily objectives, feedback, and better session flow
summary: This update adds Daily Objective, lightweight post-session feedback, app sharing, and better polish around active sessions. It also improves visuals, notifications, and Shield behavior.
notes:
## Focus experience expanded
This release adds a few lightweight features and improves how sessions feel before, during, and after focus time.

## What's improved
- Added Daily Objective to Focus
- Added lightweight post-session feedback
- Added native app sharing
- Added a teaser for future companions on intro screens
- Improved theme consistency
- Improved end-of-session urgency visuals
- Improved notifications and Shield reliability

## Overall result
Focus sessions feel more guided, more alive, and better supported.
